header.title: About
header.desc: Product version, runtime environment, core capabilities and tech stack. Copy diagnostics in one click for feedback.

hero.title: DDI Unified IP Address Management Platform
hero.desc: An integrated product covering IPAM, DHCPv4/v6, DNS and unified logging. It provides address planning, automated provisioning, resolution services and security auditing for enterprise intranets. It runs fully offline with no GPL dependencies.

page.title: Account management
page.desc: Manage control plane accounts, role assignment and enabled state. Passwords are stored with bcrypt; disabling an account or changing its password revokes its existing sessions immediately.

role.auditorDesc: Read-only across all modules, suited to audit roles

confirm.totpTitle: Reset two-factor authentication for this account?
confirm.totpDesc: This clears the TOTP binding and recovery codes, invalidates existing sessions, and requires the user to bind again.

form.editHint: Changing roles or status revokes the account's existing sessions immediately; the last administrator cannot be demoted or disabled.

page.title: Role management
page.desc: Define roles by permission domain × read/write. Built-in roles cannot be modified or deleted; permissions of custom roles can be adjusted at any time.

page.title: Backup and restore
page.desc: Back up PostgreSQL, the config directory and ClickHouse logs; supports download, restore and a daily policy. Restoring overwrites current data, so run it in a maintenance window.

stat.logHint: Log months included in the last successful backup

list.title: Backup records
list.empty: No backups yet. Click “Back up now” in the top right to create one

confirm.restoreDesc: This overwrites current PostgreSQL data and ClickHouse logs; the admin UI may be briefly unavailable meanwhile.
confirm.deleteDesc: The backup file and record are deleted together and cannot be recovered.

policy.title: Automatic backup policy
policy.dataHint: Automatic backups include PG, the config directory and ClickHouse log Parquet files
policy.scheduleHint: Checked once a day and executed in UTC
policy.retentionHint: Backups beyond the retention count are deleted automatically; create and download one manually before an upgrade.

modal.title: Back up now
modal.hint: Backups run in the background; the status refreshes every 5 seconds. Large log volumes may take several minutes.

msg.created: Backup task created and running in the background
msg.restored: Restore completed; refresh the page if data looks wrong

page.title: Directory service
page.desc: Integrate with enterprise LDAP / Active Directory: directory accounts sign in directly and roles are mapped by group; passwords are always verified by the directory and never stored by the platform.

stat.serviceHintOn: Directory accounts can sign in; local accounts are unaffected
stat.sourceHint: Shadow accounts are created on first directory sign-in
stat.bindingHint: The platform does not cache directory passwords

alert.tlsDesc: Only recommended for test environments; configure trusted certificates in production to prevent directory passwords from being intercepted.

connection.title: Connection settings
connection.enableHint: When enabled, unknown accounts try directory authentication; local accounts still use local passwords
connection.serverHint: Prefer ldaps:// or enable StartTLS; AD domain controllers usually use ldap://dc.corp.local:389
connection.baseDnHint: User search root, e.g. dc=corp,dc=local for AD
connection.bindDnHint: Required when the directory does not allow anonymous search
connection.bindPasswordSet: Configured; leave blank to keep it
connection.bindPasswordHint: You can also inject it via the IPAM_LDAP_BIND_PASSWORD environment variable to avoid storing it
connection.userFilterHint: {ph} is the placeholder; AD uses (sAMAccountName={ph}), OpenLDAP uses (uid={ph})

mapping.title: Group and role mapping
mapping.hint: The default role is used when no group matches
mapping.groupFilterHint: {ph} is the user DN; AD can use (&(objectClass=group)(member={ph}))
mapping.newGroupPlaceholder: Group identifier, e.g. ipam-ops or cn=ipam-ops,ou=groups,dc=corp,dc=local
mapping.empty: No mappings yet; directory accounts use the default role

test.title: Connectivity test
test.hint: Performs a real bind with the given directory account without creating an account
test.before: Save the connection settings before testing

msg.required: Server address and Base DN are required when directory service is enabled

page.title: License management
page.desc: Offline license file management with Ed25519 signature verification; once activated it shows edition, capabilities, expiry and active terminal metering. Exceeding the limit only warns.

activate.title: Activate license
activate.label: License file contents (JSON)
activate.hintText: Activation verifies the signature and validity first; a failure leaves the current license untouched. It takes effect as soon as the file is written.
activate.footerHint: Obtain licenses through official channels in production; the private key is held by the licensor

confirm.removeDesc: The product returns to the community edition and licensed capabilities may stop working immediately.

msg.removed: License removed; now running the community edition

page.title: Account security
page.desc: Manage password policy, forced password change on first sign-in and login protection centrally; accounts and roles are maintained in Account management and Role management.

stat.forceHintOn: New or reset accounts must change their password at first sign-in
stat.forceHintOff: Convenient for debugging; enable it before delivery
stat.protectionHint: Rate limited per client IP; old sessions expire immediately after a password change

card.switchTitle: Force password change after first sign-in / password reset
card.onDesc: After a new account is created or an administrator resets its password, the user must change it at first sign-in
card.offDesc: No forced change; suited to debugging, accounts still record the “password change required” state
card.hint: When enabled it only affects accounts created or passwords reset afterwards and does not kick existing sessions; disabling it does not clear existing “password change required” flags, it only stops blocking at sign-in.
card.footerHint: Enable it before delivery; it can be turned off while debugging

fixed.title: Fixed password policy
fixed.hint: Verified centrally by the backend and shared by creation/reset/self-service change
fixed.afterChangeValue: Sessions on other devices expire immediately

msg.enabled: Enabled: new accounts and reset passwords must change at first sign-in
msg.disabled: Disabled: password change is no longer forced at first sign-in (convenient for debugging)
